cousin.definition: A child of your aunt or your uncle. A cousin is like a brother or sister, but not a real one.
cousin.example: My cousin Mai is my age. We play together every weekend.

dual_unwritten_rule.definition: A rule that a group follows although nobody has written it down.
dual_unwritten_rule.example: The unwritten rule was that nobody questioned the schedule.

gd_projection.definition: Putting your own act on the other person, and calling it the other person's character.
gd_projection.example: It was projection: the person who had been aggressive called the other one aggressive.

introduce_yourself.definition: To say your name to somebody for the first time. It only means saying your name.
introduce_yourself.example: I introduced myself and said, I am An.

maintainability.definition: How easily software can be understood, fixed and extended by a human in the future.
